purpose: Freeze and audit the exact primary-paper height-correction formula before any GLO-30 tile body retrieval. Extraction is conditional on formula identifiability.

frozen_primary_formula.equation_7: A_over_S = tan(mean over 16 azimuth sections of terrain elevation angle)
frozen_primary_formula.correction_application: add delta_u_HC(z) to the interpolated forecast wind speed at z

gate_order: only if u(h_HC) is identified for every relevant grid may a DEM tile body be retrieved

identifiability_rule.PASS_AND_EXTRACT: The supplied archive must expose a comparable mean horizontal wind vector that brackets every paper-implied h_HC, or the primary paper must prescribe an exact reconstruction supported by the supplied variables.
identifiability_rule.BLOCKED_UNIDENTIFIED_U_HHC_NO_TILE_GET: If u(h_HC) is absent/unbracketed or needs a new extrapolation/free choice, stop before any DEM GET/range/body request. Do not substitute u(10m), LDAPS 50m extrema, GFS vectors, or a learned vertical profile.

forbidden: DEM tile GET/range/body unless identifiability passes
